## TemplateEngine.compileBlockMessage() method

Compiles message blocks from a template into executable functions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static compileBlockMessage(template: string, baseBlocks?: ReturnType<typeof TemplateEngine._processBaseBlocks>): {
        [baseId: string]: {
            [lang: string]: (data?: Record<string, any>) => string;
        };
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ \[baseId: string\]: { \[lang: string\]: (data?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;) =&gt; string; }; }

Compiled message functions organized by base ID and language

## Remarks

This method parses `<message>` blocks from the template and compiles them into functions that generate rendered message strings. The result is organized by base ID and language. Pre-parsed base blocks can be provided for efficiency.

Processing pipeline (in order, per message): 1. `_processScriptBlocks` - converts `<script>` blocks into executable expressions 2. `_processMapBlocks` - converts `<map>` blocks into array map expressions 3. `_processSwitchBlocks` - converts `<switch>` blocks into switch expressions 4. `_processScopeExec` - evaluates scope execution blocks (implementation-defined) 5. `_processScopeVariables` - resolves scope variables (implementation-defined) 6. `_compileToFunction(processed, false)` - produces the final render function

Output shape: - First level key: `baseId` (from `<base id="...">`<!-- -->, or `"default"` if omitted) - Second level key: `lang` (from `<message lang="...">`<!-- -->, or `"default"` if omitted) - Value: `(data?: Record<string, any>) => string`

## Example


```typescript
const template = `
  <base>
    <message>Hello {{name}}!</message>
    <message lang="id">Halo {{name}}!</message>
  </base>
`;
const messages = TemplateEngine.compileMessages(template);
const result = messages.default.default({ name: 'John' });
// Result: 'Hello John!'
```
